summary: Grupo Cibest files Form 6-K reporting 1Q26 financial results, disclosing a December 2025 share purchase agreement to sell 100% of Banistmo S.A. to Inversiones Cuscatlán Centroamérica S.A. Price terms, premium, and advisor are not stated. Banistmo is classified as held for sale and a discontinued operation under IFRS 5, with separate presentation of assets, liabilities, and results. The sale represents a significant line of business. Net income attributable to shareholders for 1Q26 was COP 1.5 trillion. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions; risk-arb centers on deal completion timing and any material adverse changes.
